svg.title: yak CSS loading
svg.desc: One page load on a timeline. With runtime CSS-in-JS, the server renders HTML and CSS, sends inline CSS, the browser loads JS with CSS inside, and the runtime rebuilds and injects the CSS before the page has its styles. With yak, 103 Early Hints sends the stylesheet first, the CSS steps go away, and the page has its styles right after the HTML.

g.text: The browser builds the CSS again
The server renders the CSS, then the runtime regenerates it in the browser.
103 Early Hints sends the stylesheet first, and the CSS steps go away.
